interpretation.oracle_vs_v1: oracle gold applies the dual-channel rule: a persisting issue symptom alone forces REJECT (v1 scored wrong_patch NEED), independent of artifact linkage
interpretation.condition_vs_v1: condition gold scores the answer the regime actually supports: withheld decisive channels turn v1 over-abstention into appropriate abstention; an institutionally presented all-green block (T2A) can turn v1 appropriate abstention into over-abstention

interpretation.oracle_standard: would the decision be appropriate with all trustworthy evidence (O and P channels)?
interpretation.condition_standard: was the decision appropriate given ONLY evidence the condition regime makes accessible?
interpretation.no_cross_condition_averaging: oracle-vs-condition deltas are descriptive; paired comparisons remain restricted to shared fixture sets
